_doc: ROWS-ONLY tile table of the row-block members (opt_core.mem.rowpair.trimul_fused, P > 1). Keys '<cc M.m>|C<c_z>|H<c_hidden>'. An entry with kernels=fpf_trimul_rows carries k1 (a-layout: the resident A block), k1b (b-layout: a b sub-block written in its GEMM layout when b_direct) and k3 (the tile epilogue) launch cells {BM, BN, num_warps, num_stages}, b_direct (bool), min_tokens (the lever's size floor at this capability x width; absent = the provider's DEFAULT_MIN_TOKENS), measured (bool) + status/evidence. measured=false / status PLACEHOLDER = tiles seeded from a neighbouring sweep, NOT raced at this unit's shapes: the provider declines such a width by name (c=<c_z>/<c_h>, the torch statements) unless ROWPAIR_TRIMUL_ROWS_UNMEASURED=1. An entry with kernels=fpf_trimul_v4 carries no tiles (those widths run the whole-plane unit's kernels with its own table.json row, unchanged) and only names the floor. 'safe': per capability ('<cc>' exact, '*' any) the conservative cells a BUILD failure of a tuned cell falls to by name. Nothing outside trimul_fused reads this file; no whole-plane provider (kernels.trimul TRIMUL_CELLS.json, fpf_trimul_v4 table.json) is affected by it. Capability coverage: cc 9.0 (H100 sweep) and cc 8.0 (A100 cells pass, opt_core 0.5.220.1); other cards have no key and keep declining c=384/384 / c=64/64 by name.

9.0|C384|H384.status: MEASURED_OP (tile sweep on one H100, bf16 z; an op-level measurement): K1 a-layout: num_stages=2 cells with BM,BN >= 64 exceed shared memory (8 BUILD_FAIL of 36 candidates, per layout); smaller s2 cells (BM 32 or BN 32) built and ran; chosen 64x128 w4 s1 fastest at every grid shape rows {256,512,768,1536} x N {1400,2432,5802,11604} ((1536,11604) not timed: torch-piece OOM), 0.76..17.6 ms = 8.5-11.6x the torch LN+projection+gate+mask+permute-copy statements (bf16 autocast); K1 b-layout (b sub-block 512 rows written in GEMM-B layout) 64x128 w4 s1, 1.40..11.0 ms at N 1400..11604 = 0.97x the a-layout kernel time AND no [384,N,512] transpose copy (1.9..15.9 ms) -> b_direct; K3 in place 64x128 w8 s1 (fastest at rows >= 512; 128x128 w8 is 2% faster at 256 rows), 0.49..2.54 ms for rows 256..1536 x w 512 = 4.2-5.0x the torch epilogue statements (+0.27..1.49 ms of window staging copies avoided). min_tokens 1400 = the smallest measured N (8.5x there); below 1400 unmeasured -> below_gate. No 8.0 key: no A100 pass yet (declined c=384/384 there).
9.0|C384|H384.evidence: sweep run-A (1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3: torch 2.10.0+cu128 / triton 3.6.0 / python 3.11.5; tree 0ff63df1b970, opt_core 0.5.214.2, fpf_trimul_rows 0.1.0; 470 csv rows); correctness on the same box: K1 max|err| 0.031 (a- and b-layout, +/-bias, bf16 and fp32 z) at plane scale ~11 (<= 1 bf16 ulp), a==b bitwise; K3 max|err| 0.031-0.0625 at scale ~11 (<= 1 ulp), in-place == staged bitwise, bytes outside the window untouched; 3 launches run-to-run bitwise

No 8.0 key: no A100 pass yet (declined c=64/64 there).

safe._doc: SAFE cells of the fpf_trimul_rows kernels per capability: single stage, small tiles (K1 32x32 w4 s1, K3 32x32 w4 s1); served BY NAME (stderr line + census settings=safe:build_failed:<Type>) only after a tuned cell fails to BUILD. 9.0: built and ran in the H100 sweep at C 384 (K1 16.3-20.5 ms at (512,5802)/(1536,2432), K3 2.0/5.8 ms at 512/1536 rows) and C 64 — valid, ~3x slower than the tuned cells. 8.0: built and ran in the A100 cells pass. '*': the same cells, unmeasured on other cards.
